chunks.text:
Product Profile
A high-yielding, early-maturing, medium-tall variety with medium-slender heavy grains, this mega variety is cultivated in India under irrigated lowland conditions. Developed and released in 1999 by ANGRAU University (Maruteru), MTU-1010 resulted from the hybridization of a local variety 'Krishnaveni' with IR64, a popular rice variety from IRRI. Known for its excellent tillering capacity and sturdy stem, it demonstrates susceptibility to leaf and sheath blight, as well as BPH. However, it shows tolerance to leaf blast, which enhances its resilience against this particular disease.
